name: Player
description: Allows access to playback controls for the associated shape in the current window.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object. Read-only.

properties.name: CurrentPosition
properties.description: Gets or sets a Long that represents the current position of the player in the media. Read/write.

properties.name: State
properties.description: Returns the current state of the player. Read-only.

methods.name: Play
methods.description: Begins playback for the specified media.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the media playing in the specified object.
